title: Concept: Schema identifier pointing at an internal path
description: A JSON schema whose identifier names an internal origin in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The identifier shows where the schema is hosted, which is usually an internal documentation server that holds the rest of the estate's contracts.
applicability: Deployments that render a JSON schema whose identifier names an internal origin into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The identifier shows where the schema is hosted, which is usually an internal documentation server that holds the rest of the estate's contracts.
